title: GraphFold analysis verdict (version 1)
description: The AnalysisReports.json serialization contract, independent of output filename (verdict.json or report.json). Verdict is derived by the engine: PASS requires no findings, no blocking diagnostics, and all obligations proved. Cross-field verdict and count equality are enforced by the engine, not this structural schema.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the serialized verdict contract; version 1 corresponds to this schema. This is independent of the GraphFold release version.

verdict.description: Engine-derived gate decision: PASS requires no findings, no blocking diagnostics, and equality of obligations and provedObligations; otherwise FAIL.

findings.description: Blocking violations anchored to verified changed source spans in the base/head diff. An empty array alone does not imply PASS.

diagnostics.description: Analysis conditions and coverage gaps, including failures without a source location. Any blocking diagnostic prevents PASS.

metadata.description: Revision identities, parsed scenarios, proof-completion counts, and the Graphite version recorded for this analysis.

reasons.description: Per-obligation explanations of proof outcomes under individual folding scenarios, including safe changes and incomplete analysis.

ruleAudits.description: Available rule-selection and fold-application records, scoped by scenario, revision, and rule index. Records may be partial when analysis fails.

revision.description: Side of the Git comparison: BASE is the baseline; HEAD is the proposed revision.

start.description: One-based coordinate of the first source position on this axis.

end.description: One-based coordinate of the exclusive end position on this axis. An end column can be less than its start column when the span crosses lines.

sourceRange.description: One axis of a source span, combined with the other axis in sourceLocation. Coordinates are one-based; the paired end position is exclusive. Column values count UTF-16 code units within their respective lines.

revision.description: Revision containing the source span; removed source is located in BASE and added source in HEAD.

path.description: Nonblank repository-relative file path. The model rejects absolute paths and paths that escape the repository after normalization.

line.description: One-based line coordinates of the start and exclusive end positions. The end line cannot precede the start line.

column.description: One-based UTF-16 column coordinates on the corresponding start and end lines, not byte offsets or display widths. End columns are ordered after start columns only for spans on the same line.

sourceLocation.description: Repository-relative source span from (line.start, column.start) to the exclusive (line.end, column.end). The model rejects escaping paths and end positions preceding the start; those cross-field constraints are not expressed by this structural schema.

description.description: Human-readable supporting evidence or remaining representation difference.

location.description: Supporting source span, or null when the evidence has no precise source location.

evidence.description: Supporting explanation for a finding, optionally anchored to a precise source span.

id.description: Nonblank identifier distinguishing this finding within the report.

kind.description: UNCONTROLLED_CHANGE identifies a change outside the specified folding control; UNVERIFIABLE_CHANGE means the changed location could not be proved safe.

ruleId.description: Nonblank identifier of the analysis rule that reported the finding; distinct from a fold-rule index.

message.description: Nonblank human-readable explanation of the violation or unresolved proof.

locations.description: Nonempty list of verified diff spans associated with the finding; may include spans from both BASE and HEAD.

evidence.description: Additional explanations supporting the finding; empty when no supplementary evidence is available.

scenarios.description: Names of folding scenarios in which this finding occurred; may be empty when no scenario is attached.

finding.description: Blocking uncontrolled or unverifiable change, anchored to one or more verified source spans from the base/head diff.

stage.description: Phase reporting the condition: input validation, Git preparation, compilation, source indexing, graph construction, folding, comparison, or report generation.

code.description: Stable machine-readable diagnostic identity. Distinguishes workspace-capacity timeout, cancellation, unexpected failure, unverified compiler origin, incomplete graph, unmatched fold rule, unmapped change, failed source resolution, and an unlocated difference after a file move.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the condition and available context.

blocking.description: Whether this diagnostic forces FAIL even when findings is empty.

diagnostic.description: Analysis condition that may prevent a reliable verdict without identifying a changed source span.

baseSha.description: Resolved base commit SHA, or the requested base revision if resolution did not complete.

headSha.description: Resolved head commit SHA, or the requested head revision if resolution did not complete.

scenarios.description: Names of parsed folding scenarios; may be empty if scenario parsing did not complete.

obligations.description: Number of obligations requiring proof; on an early failure this may instead reflect pending changed files. PASS requires equality with provedObligations.

provedObligations.description: Number of obligations proved across every analyzed scenario, rather than the total of individual scenario proofs.

graphiteVersion.description: Graphite dependency version recorded by the analysis; distinct from schemaVersion and the GraphFold release version.

metadata.description: Revision identities and proof progress for the completed or partial analysis.

changes.description: Distinct syntax-level change categories associated with the obligation. These describe what changed, independently of whether the change is safe.

code.description: FOLDED_EQUIVALENT means no analyzed folded difference survives; UNREACHABLE means the change is unreachable under the entry model and assumptions; SURVIVING_DIFFERENCE means a difference remains; ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE means a gap prevents a safety conclusion.

message.description: Human-readable explanation of the proof outcome.

locations.description: Diff spans associated with the obligation; may be empty for a pure file move.

scenario.description: Name of the folding scenario used for this proof.

basePath.description: Repository-relative old file path, or null when the base path is absent or unspecified.

headPath.description: Repository-relative new file path, or null when the head path is absent or unspecified.

reason.description: Explanation of a change obligation outcome under one folding scenario, independent of whether it produces a finding.

kind.description: CYPHER selects call sites with a query; CALL_SITE_MATCH selects them using a configured constant-fold call-site match.

query.description: Cypher query text for CYPHER selectors; null for CALL_SITE_MATCH selectors.

description.description: Description supplied by the fold rule to identify its intended selection.

selector.description: Description of how a fold rule selects candidate call sites.

signature.description: Graphite method signature identifying the caller or callee; a graph identity rather than a verified source declaration.

descriptor.description: JVM method descriptor containing parameter and return types.

method.description: Method identity reported by Graphite for a selected call site.

nodeId.description: Raw call-site node identifier within this scenario and revision; not a stable identifier across graphs or revisions.

caller.description: Graphite identity of the method containing this invocation.

callee.description: Graphite identity of the method targeted by this invocation.

ordinal.description: Invocation ordinal reported by the raw graph, or null when unavailable. It is not a source offset and may reflect synthetic bytecode.

originNodeId.description: Origin-node identifier reported by Graphite for this call site, or null when no origin is recorded; scoped to the same graph.

lineNumber.description: Bytecode debug line number reported by Graphite, or null when unavailable. It may be synthetic and is not a verified sourceLocation.

selectedCallSite.description: Raw, unfolded graph call site selected by a rule. Node identifiers are scoped to one scenario and revision. Ordinals and debug lines may be synthetic or unavailable and are not verified source locations.

scenario.description: Name of the folding scenario containing this rule.

revision.description: Revision whose raw graph was selected and folded.

ruleIndex.description: Zero-based index of the rule within its scenario.

selector.description: Selector kind, optional query, and rule description used for this audit.

selectionStatus.description: NOT_EXECUTED means selection has not run; SELECTED means selection completed, including an empty result; FAILED means selection failed before a completed selection was recorded. A later fold failure can retain SELECTED.

selectedNodes.description: Unique raw call-site nodes captured by a completed selection, sorted by node identifier. Empty can mean zero matches or unavailable selection; consult selectionStatus.

matchedCallCount.description: Independent count reported by Graphite when applying the fold, which may differ from selectedCount. Null means unavailable; zero is a measured count.

message.description: Available selection or fold-failure message, or null when no message was recorded. A message can accompany successfully captured selected nodes.

selectedCount.description: Number of unique selectedNodes when selectionStatus is SELECTED; otherwise null. Zero means a completed selection found no nodes, not that selection was skipped.

ruleAudit.description: Audit of one fold rule in one scenario and revision. Selection and fold application are independent: selectedCount counts unique raw selected nodes, while matchedCallCount comes from Graphite fold application and can differ. A later fold failure can retain SELECTED nodes and a message. The model derives selectedCount from selectedNodes; this schema does not assert their equality.

selectionStatus.description: Applies the successful-selection count constraint only when selection completed.

selectedCount.description: A completed selection reports a measured nonnegative count, including zero.
The selected-node count is unavailable unless selection completed successfully.
